CustomField.description: Short subtitle under the page title on this page's stage card in Stages Mode. Keep it to one or two sentences that help a respondent decide whether to open the stage. No effect in page-by-page forms, which have no overview. Up to 500 characters.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter a one- or two-sentence subtitle that appears under the page title on its Stages-view card. A short summary of what the stage covers helps respondents decide whether to start it; this text only shows when the parent Form Template is in Stages Mode.
CustomField.label: Description
